name: Choe Bu's drift to China
summary: A Joseon official on Jeju sets sail for home on news of his father's death. A storm drives his boat across the sea for two weeks to the coast of Zhejiang, where he is taken for a Japanese pirate. Sent north up the Grand Canal to Beijing and home by land, he writes, at the king's order, the Pyohaerok: the fullest account of Ming China's south by any foreigner.

stops.note: He sails for the mainland with 42 men.
After fourteen days adrift they land and are taken for Japanese pirates.
Through the pass at the end of the Great Wall.
He writes his diary for the king before going home to mourn.
